summary.text: Bill Reineke is a member of the Ohio Senate, representing District 26, which includes Union, Crawford, Marion, Morrow, Sandusky, Seneca and Wyandot counties. The Senate's biography says he is serving his second term and was elected by his colleagues as President Pro Tempore for the 136th General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: According to the Senate's biography, Reineke attended Morehead State University and is a business partner in Reineke Family Dealerships, a three-generation family business with 10 dealerships and over 400 employees.
It says he is a 41-year resident of Tiffin and has worked with the Seneca County Chamber of Commerce, Tiffin Seneca Economic Partnership, Tiffin Tomorrow and the Tiffin Rotary Club.
The biography says Reineke previously served three terms in the Ohio House of Representatives.

It names workforce development and job creation as his foremost priority, which he pursues as a member of the Governor's Executive Workforce Board, and lists him as vice chair of the Rules and Reference Committee.
